duplication_audit.distinction: P3 v55 estimates local-neighbor divergence, v29 recurrence geometry, and v41 a fixed reservoir state. v72 uses no embedding, neighbors, learned state, or prior output: it summarizes correlation-form translation diffusion at eight sealed nonresonant frequencies.
duplication_audit.cross_problem_adjacency: P1 v40 used a related 0-1 diagnostic on a different task/data/action; P3 has no executed exact or semantic equivalent.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: hs/tp/hmax/wspd past-only native channels transformed to the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.normalization: median and 1.4826 times MAD; zero-scale maps to zero
encoder.translation: p_c=sum phi_j cos(jc), q_c=sum phi_j sin(jc); correlation of lag and mean-square displacement

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Gottwald and Melbourne, A new test for chaos in deterministic systems, Proceedings of the Royal Society A 460 (2004)
primary_sources.use: translation-diffusion diagnostic motivation only; no P3 performance claim
